scope: R1 plus R2 model/information structure, no formal difficulty calibration

A1.criterion: R1 covers all 21 record/N cells and supplies combined phase figure; correct unresolved entries count as coverage.

A2.criterion: Phase assignments are justified by increasing two-dimensional sizes, fit/crossover sensitivity, and do not turn slow drift into a settled asymptotic limit.

A3.criterion: Statistical, finite-size and approximation/rounding uncertainty are separated; approximation robustness claim supported rather than inferred from two approximations agreeing.

A4.criterion: Exact theorem, sufficient bound, numerical phase inference and unresolved region distinguished; failed sufficient inequality not interpreted as nondecodability.

A5.criterion: Equivalent-channel rows and information inclusions are consistent, including treatment of Z4 high-noise apparent reversals and lack of enriched complement symmetry.

B1.criterion: Noise, geometry, syndrome, sectors and average risk defined consistently.

B2.criterion: Data processing proves same-N information order; any cross-N order used is justified, not presumed by increasing N.

B3.criterion: O1 parity/CRT equivalences and full integer-charge saturation including N5 are derived; mod4 vs mod6 kept distinct.

B4.criterion: Low-rank SU(2) V≅Vbar and irrep count laws handled correctly where used.

important_limits: No independent gold phase for central O1. Insufficient evidence does not establish that a guessed phase is false.
Different valid sufficient N0 or proof curves are not mutually inconsistent.
Drawing explanatory arrows and all later tutorial detail were not original deliverables; omissions not automatically scientific failures.
Scores are diagnostic and no organizer official pass cutoff is inferred.

reference_bounds.strict_root_warning: Listed conservative decimals satisfy strict inequality with certificates; exact root equality is not asserted decodable.
